description: This week, Fox News revealed that Roy Cooper has spent over $270,000 on private security over the past year, after releasing more than 4,200 convicted criminals from prison when he was governor. More than 50% of these criminals went on to be arrested again with 25 murdering a North Carolinian, 99 committing sexual assault, and more than 600 committing a violent felony. While North Carolina families are left to suffer the consequences, Roy Cooper has expensive private security to ensure his own safety.
